{{Top|leg}}
The '''RapidResponse module system''' was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] system that allowed owners to quickly reprogram their units. As many duties required a specific set of instruction, the RapidResponse allowed for the droid to be retasked with a minimum of effort. [[GLD-M General Labor Droid/Mining]] units were fitted with this system, allowing them to switch between several tasks such as aiding [[Resource Recon Speeder]]s, operational planning, piloting [[Skiff/Legends|skiffs]], or debris clearance.
